# uMeta

> uMeta is a free tool by Frivaro that inspects a file's hidden metadata (EXIF, GPS, author, software, etc.) and lets you remove it before sharing - entirely inside your browser. Nothing is ever uploaded.

## Pages

- [uMeta](https://umeta.frivaro.com/): Inspect a file's hidden metadata, choose what to remove, and download a cleaned copy.
